messages.content: 如果一個球以5米/秒的速度直接向上投擲，它將達到什麼加速度？

function.name: calculate_maximum_height
function.description: Calculate the maximum height an object will reach if it's thrown straight upwards with an initial velocity, ignoring air resistance. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_velocity.description: The initial velocity in meters per second. This is a float type value.

gravity.description: The acceleration due to gravity in meters per second squared, default value is 9.8. This is a float type value.

message.content:
當你把球以 5 m/s 的初速度直接向上拋出時，球在空中受到的重力加速度（忽略空氣阻力）是常數，方向向下。  
在地球表面，這個加速度約為  

\[
g \approx 9.8 \text{ m/s}^2
\]

因此，球在上升過程中的加速度是 **-9.8 m/s²**（負號表示方向與初速度相反，即向下）。  

> **注意**：如果你想知道球能夠上升到多高，可以使用公式  
> \[
> h_{\max} = \frac{v_0^2}{2g}
> \]  
> 其中 \(v_0 = 5\) m/s，\(g = 9.8\) m/s²，得到  
> \[
> h_{\max} \approx \frac{25}{19.6} \approx 1.28 \text{ m}
> \]  
> 這是球在空中最高點離地面的距離。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "如果一個球以5米/秒的速度直接向上投擲，它將達到什麼加速度？" They want the acceleration? Actually they ask: "What acceleration will it reach?" But acceleration due to gravity is constant -9.8 m/s^2 downward. So answer: -9.8 m/s^2. But maybe they want maximum height? The question: "If a ball is thrown straight up at 5 m/s, what acceleration will it reach?" That seems wrong: acceleration is constant. So answer: -9.8 m/s^2. Provide explanation. No function call needed.
